text:
Rina: quick notes from today's UX pass on the playground schema + tool-calling flow. main problems: cramped schema panel, copy UX, and run-history replay oddities. jotting down decisions so eng/design can align.
Omar: saw the copy button get hidden on mobile when functions have lots of params. also the example payload doesn't highlight on focus which makes keyboard copy awkward. :clipboard:
Priya: accessibility: suggest a visible 'Copy example' text button (not just icon) so screen readers + low-vision users have a clear target. also add aria-describedby with the shortcut hint.
Sam: run-history bug: when you open an old run and expand the tool block, schema sometimes shows a blank box until you expand/collapse again. looks like lazy-load + virtualization mismatch. can repro on staging.
Rina: proposal: default to a small modal inspector that can "float" as a detachable side-panel. modal reduces layout-shift, detach supports side-by-side diffs.
Omar: implementation note: for the detach behavior, persist state in session storage so reopening run-history keeps the detached view if the user prefers.
Priya: microcopy: rename CTA from "View schema" to "Open request schema (read-only)" and add a sublabel: "Tip: press ⌘/Ctrl+C to copy example". This sets expectation and helps discoverability.
Sam: dev plan: fix hydration so inspector renders on first open, reuse existing prettyJSON util for formatting, and add pagination for enormous schemas (>120 lines) to avoid jank.
Rina: a11y specifics: modal must have role=dialog, aria-labelledby the heading, focus trap, and initial focus on the search field. For copy feedback use aria-live polite region that announces "Example copied" and remains until next copy.
Omar: icon color check: current clipboard icon (#98A3B0) fails contrast at 12px. use #58606A or bump to 14px. add visible focus ring for keyboard.
Priya: keyboard flow: when modal opens, focus -> search, Tab -> copy -> pagination -> close. Esc closes the modal. For detached panel, preserve same shortcut behavior and support global close (Esc).
Rina: follow-ups (owners):
- Sam: fix run-history lazy render/hydration + session storage for detach state
- Priya: implement aria-live copy feedback + update button markup (text + icon)
- Omar: update icon colors and focus styles, add contrast check in CI
- Rina: update microcopy and add hint under button in the design kit
Please add time estimates in RD-UX ticket.
Sam: quick poll: modal default? react :one: for modal, :two: for panel.
Priya: :one:
Omar: :one: (modal default, detachable)
Rina: :one: (modal with detach)
UX-Bot: created ticket RD-UX-3264 "Playground: request schema inspector 1 modal default + detachable panel, copy accessibility fixes, run-history hydration" and linked this thread.
